gloss: to suddenly remember; to recall out of the blue

definitions.gloss: to suddenly remember; to recall out of the blue
definitions.explanation: To have a memory come to mind unexpectedly, without deliberately trying to recall it.

examples.japanese: ふと{昔|むかし}のことを{思|おも}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I suddenly remembered something from the past.

examples.japanese: {歩|ある}いていたら、ふと{友人|ゆうじん}の{言葉|ことば}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: While walking, I suddenly recalled my friend's words.

examples.japanese: この{匂|にお}いを{嗅|か}ぐと、ふと{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}す。
examples.english: When I smell this scent, it suddenly brings back memories of my childhood.

notes:
Combines the adverb ふと (suddenly, unexpectedly) with {思|おも}い{出|だ}す (to remember). The key nuance is that the memory surfaces involuntarily — triggered by a sensation, a scene, or seemingly nothing at all. Very common in everyday conversation and narrative writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ふと{昔|むかし}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}す: to suddenly recall the past
- ふと{母|はは}のことを{思|おも}い{出|だ}す: to suddenly think of one's mother
- ふと{思|おも}い{出|だ}したように: as if suddenly remembering

USAGE:
ふと can also combine with other verbs to express sudden, unplanned actions:
- ふと{気|き}がつく: to suddenly notice
- ふと{見|み}る: to glance inadvertently
- ふと{目|め}が{覚|さ}める: to wake up suddenly
